//why: tsconfig.json is include:["src"], so this file exists to typecheck test/, scripts/ and tools/ too, where every validator lives. A type-level completeness guard placed in an unchecked directory would be inert, which is why the completion guard test/lib/verdict-guard.ts is a RUNTIME assertion instead.
//types: These directories run on Node, not in workerd, so they need @types/node and the DOM lib rather than the WebWorker-only shape src/ compiles against.
//allowJs: allowJs brings the .mjs files under scripts/, tools/ and test/ into the program, so an .mjs export used at the wrong type from a .ts file is a type error rather than silently any. checkJs is deliberately NOT set here: turning it on would also check the .mjs bodies themselves, which is a separate, larger change (see tsconfig.checkjs.json).
//excluded: test/vitest/** is excluded: those files run under vitest with the workers pool, not as validator processes, and are typed separately by `npm run test:vitest`.
